:::: content-container
::: welcome
:::
::::
::::::::::::::::::

We are an interdisciplinary research group focused on **chemical ecology**, **natural product chemistry**, and **vector biology**. Our research investigates how ticks detect hosts and respond to repellents, translating fundamental discoveries into innovative, environmentally responsible solutions for tick management and disease prevention.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Announcement: Canada’s First Tick Research & Innovation Centre

Join us on **Tuesday, August 25 at 11:30am** for an exciting announcement of funding for the Canadian Tick Research and Innovation Centre (CTRIC) at Acadia University. The event will also be held in person at McCain Commons, 2nd floor, David Huestis Innovation Pavilion, Acadia University, Wolfville, NS, Canada.
